I'm your friendly SFA chatbot! Think of me as your first line of support for all SFA-related concerns.

I'll help you resolve this customer visibility issue. First, try performing a Customer Reset in your app. If the customer is still missing, I can check the dim_customer table using your FSP code or email. This might be a sync issue - the data could still be loading. If confirmed missing after verification, I'll escalate this to our Data Warehouse or SAP team (Ms. Bev) for immediate assistance.

Let's fix this customer issue together. Start with a Customer Reset in the app. Still not showing? The data might not have synced yet, or it could be missing from our database. I can verify this for you and escalate to the right team if needed.

It looks like your MCP (Monthly Call Plan) isn't displaying properly. This is often due to weak internet connection or incomplete sync. Please try logging out and logging back in, or clear your app data. I'll also check the fct_visits table to verify your data on the server. Note: STD = MCP and STD2 = Adhoc visits.
MCP not showing? This usually happens with connectivity issues. Try logging out/in or clearing app data. I can check if your MCP data exists on our server side too.

I see you're having trouble with ship-to-party data. Please perform a Customer Reset first. I'll check the dim_shiptoparty table using your customer code (kunnr) to verify if the data exists on our server. If the table is partially populated, our ETL job might still be running. If data is truly missing, I'll escalate this to DW or SAP (Ms. Bev) right away.
Ship-to-party missing? Start with a Customer Reset. I'll verify if the data exists in our system or if it's still loading. We'll get this sorted out quickly.

Let me help you with the discount issue. First, perform a Discount Reset in your app. I'll then check the dim_discount table using your customer code (kunnr) to see if a discount is maintained for the specific material group. If no discount is found in our system, I'll escalate this to SAP for validation. Note: ktber = discount type, matkl = material group.
Discount not appearing? Do a Discount Reset first. I'll verify if there's a discount maintained in the system for your customer and material group.

I understand you're not seeing an SO number for your finalized order. Let me check the integration criteria: the visit must be Finalized, po_num_supp should be 20 (integrated) or 5 (SDO offer), n1 must equal 1.00, and ship_to_party cannot be null. I'll verify these conditions in the fct_visits or fct_other_sales table. If there are error messages (especially from Tele users), I'll escalate to Sir Nino for validation. This could also mean the SAP program hasn't run yet.
SO number not generated? Let me check if all integration criteria are met - finalized status, correct po_num_supp, n1 value, and ship_to_party. It might also be that SAP processing is still pending.

I'll investigate this DR status issue for you. There might be a delay in the Data Warehouse update. Let me confirm with Bry if the DR is cleared in our fct_customer_dr_ar table using the DR number. If it's cleared but still visible on mobile, I'll check if the DW has been updated. If it's not showing in DW, that confirms the DR is cleared successfully.
DR still showing after payment? This could be a DW sync delay. I'll verify the actual status in our system and ensure everything is properly updated.

It appears the SRP (Suggested Retail Price) for this item isn't showing. This could be due to a recent update in SAP that hasn't reflected in SFA yet. I'll verify with Ma'am Bev for SAP updates or Sir JD if this concerns the Data Warehouse.
SRP missing? This might be a recent SAP update that hasn't synced to SFA yet. I'll check with the appropriate team to get this resolved.

I see your time entries are missing. This often happens due to weak internet connection during sync. Please log out and log back in, or clear your app data. I'll check the fct_visits, fct_prospect, or fct_expenses table (depending on the module) to verify if the time data (t1 for Time In, t2 for Time Out) was captured on our server.
Time entries gone? Usually a sync issue due to poor connection. Try logging out/in or clearing app data. I can verify if the time data was captured on our end.

There's a known issue with PO number formatting in the mobile backend, especially for SDO offers (FF-ABC format). I'll verify all scenarios in the backend that generate PO numbers and escalate this for resolution if needed.

patterns: Cannot log time for adhoc customer
Adhoc customer not showing until MCP logged
Need to log MCP first before adhoc
responses: This is a known bug where you can't log time for an ad-hoc customer during the first call - the option only appears after logging time for a planned visit (MCP). The customer list query has been revised to fix this issue in newer versions. Please update your app if possible.

patterns: Shows delivered instead of not yet paid
responses: I see the payment status is displaying incorrectly. This is a data issue from the Warehousing side, not the mobile app. I need to coordinate with Sir JD to fully load the data on the backend. Once all DRs are fully loaded, you'll need to resync your app. There's no problem with the mobile display or queries.

patterns: Collection status shows transmitted on mobile but for transmittal on web
Status mismatch between mobile and web
responses: This status mismatch issue has been fixed. An additional filter for 'For transmittal' status was added to sync mobile and web displays properly.

patterns: Cannot transmit PR for resigned SDO
PR transmittal blocked due to resignation
responses: This scenario wasn't included in the original module blueprint. For resigned SDO cases, we'll need to manually transmit the PR via database script. I'll handle this for you.
The industry code exists in SAP but wasn't synced to SFA. I'll coordinate with Ma'am Bev to verify and update the data sync for you.

patterns: SFA and SAP DR amount different
responses: There's a data discrepancy between SAP BW and DW causing this mismatch. I'll coordinate with Sir JD to verify and reconcile the data for accurate DR amounts.

Your sales approval transactions might not have fully synced. Try a Customer Reset first, then log out and log back in, or clear your app data. I'll check the fct_sales_approval table to verify if the data exists on our server.

Your credit request data might not have synced properly due to weak internet connection. Please log out and log back in, or clear app data. I'll verify the fct_credit_request table for your transactions.

Let me check both the header and details tables for you. I'll first verify if a header exists in rep_dr_info_header. If there's a header, I'll check the corresponding details in rep_dr_info_details. If there's no header at all, it means no data was downloaded from the Data Warehouse - I'll verify with the DW team.
To return an 'Approved' MCP status back to the SDO for reuploading, I'll need to request a manual backend update from Bam or Sir Nin.

patterns: Order header saved but no items
fct_other_sales has header but no fct_orders items
responses: This can happen due to internet interruption during order submission, or when the header and items are inserted separately. I'll verify both fct_orders and fct_other_sales tables using the appkey to check for missing items.

patterns: Where do new account orders go
responses: For new accounts, orders are routed to fct_orders where xtype = 'NA'. This helps track initial purchase orders for newly maintained accounts.
This could be due to intermittent connection issues. I'll validate the order item counts by checking fct_orders items (mtnr field) against fct_other_sales to ensure data consistency.

patterns: How to check old past due
responses: I can help you check old past due records. Old past due means DRs that are 60+ days past their due date. I'll run a query on fct_customer_dr_ar that calculates: NOT DUE YET (negative days), DUE TODAY (0 days), PAST DUE 1-30 days, PAST DUE 31-60 days, and OLD PAST DUE (60+ days). The query checks where clr_doc_no = 0 and ar_tag = 'O'.

patterns: PR not appearing in collection receiving
responses: This might be due to a missing re-sync flag on your mobile device. Please ask Tele to transmit again, then re-sync your device. I'll also check if the DR is properly opened in the system (ar_tag = O, clr_doc_no = 0, is_inputted = blank). If it's open but not visible, I'll escalate to Sir JD.
For recent transactions, please note that BW (Business Warehouse) processes data with a 2-hour interval. I'll check the BW system for status or any processing delays.

patterns: Setup DR inquiry for my account
DR inquiry not working for my customer
responses: I can help set up DR inquiry data for your account. The system shows DRs from the last 2 months (based on dr_date). I'll check rep_dr_visibility_bw for the summary, rep_dr_info_header for DR headers, rep_dr_info_details for item details, and dim_customer to verify customer assignment. If data needs to be manually created, I'll handle that for you.

patterns: Can I finalize order with old past due
Customer has old PD can I finalize
responses: No, the app cannot finalize an order if the customer has an old past due (has_past_due = 2). The validation checks in this order: BLOCKED (is_blocked = 1), HAS_PD (has_past_due = 1), HAS_OLD_PD (has_past_due = 2). You must resolve the old past due before finalizing.

patterns: PO returned need to change attachment
responses: Yes, if an SSA returns a booking transaction via the PO attachment module, you CAN overwrite attachment 1. Attachments 2-10 are also editable. To verify uploaded images, I can check the fct_image_validation table.
I'll check for partial DRs by querying fct_customer_dr_ar where ar_tag = 'P' joined with dim_customer. This will show all customers with partial delivery receipts.

This was a bug where is_unified became NULL during updates. We've added validation when updating fct_other_sales or fct_visits to prevent is_unified from being set to NULL. This should no longer occur in the latest version.

For manual data import to SFA DB, I recommend using DBeaver IDE (modern) instead of MySQL Workbench. Here's the process: 1) Check column constraints (NOT NULL, etc.) and use Default/Expression if needed. 2) For blank values, fill with 'NULL' if necessary. 3) Remove unused columns for faster import. 4) Use table column names in your sheet for easy alignment. For large datasets (250k+ rows), import in batches of 50-100k rows. Steps: Right-click table → Import Data → Select CSV → Map columns (use DELETE to skip) → Configure settings → Proceed.

Here's the transport process: 1) Create MOP (Method of Procedure). 2) Create ticket at https://help.fireflyelectric.com/support/catalog/items/214. 3) Get approval from Process Owner. 4) Validation by Sir JD. 5) Approval by Sir Mo. 6) Post in 'Deployment GC' with format: <Greeting> <Reason>, MOP Link, Ticket No: #SR-####, Timing, Created by, Validated by: Sir JD, Approved by: Sir Mo, Reference Ticket No. CC @Moses @JD Regoso @Jake Bustamante.
